items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Brasília (DF) is procuring healthcare goods or services through electronic pregão (reverse auction); proposals close Nov 18, 08:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
